_comment: Shared cases for the session filter's subsequence match (#545).
Two implementations exist because the TUI is Go and the dashboard is JavaScript:
fuzzyMatch in internal/tui/model.go, and its twin in internal/web/static/lib.js.
A rule copied per consumer is what #421, #422 and #466 were, so neither copy is
read this file and must agree on every case.
Keep the text to what a session title, machine name or branch realistically
holds — Go and JavaScript case-fold a few non-Latin scripts differently, and
this fixture is not the place to discover which.

cases.why: a plain substring is a subsequence
gaps are allowed — the point of the rule
case is ignored in the pattern
case is ignored in the text
a character absent from the text fails the whole match
a pattern longer than the text cannot match
spaces are ordinary characters and must be matched too
a repeated pattern character needs two occurrences
three of them do not exist here
the empty text matches only the empty pattern
a pattern may span two fields of the haystack
accented Latin folds the same in both languages
digits and punctuation are ordinary characters
a status is searchable, it is part of the haystack
rc is only special as a whole pattern; as text it matches normally
